name: vendor-evaluation-matrix
description: Evaluate vendors on weighted criteria (capability fit / reliability / security + compliance / total cost of ownership / commercial terms / implementation complexity / vendor viability / support + partnership / data residency + GDPR / exit strategy + lock-in). TCO: direct + integration + change + operate + exit costs. SLA definition with vendors: uptime + response + resolution + credits + exclusions. Vendor risk assessment (financial / operational / concentration / fourth-party). Produces weighted scorecard + risk register + recommendation. Not legal or procurement advice.
